title: Indoor Temperature Stability by Room
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mould:risk
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(surface_temp_c) as high, min(surface_temp_c) as low by room _time
| eval swing=round(high-low,1)
| stats avg(swing) as avg_swing by room
| sort - avg_swing
description: Measures how much each room's temperature swings through the day, revealing poor insulation or draughts.
value: Big daily temperature swings point to insulation gaps; ranking rooms shows where improvements pay off most.
implementation: Ingest room temperatures into `index=personal`; compare daily swing per room.
visualization: Bar chart of average daily temperature swing by room.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how much each room's temperature changes through the day, hinting where insulation is poor.
